guest.bio_context: Dr. Fred Moss spent 46 years in mental health, including 36 years as a psychiatrist, working within conventional psychiatry before questioning the system he devoted his career to. He grew up in Detroit, Michigan, and was the third of four children. After dropping out of college twice, he took a job in a state mental hospital with adolescent boys before attending medical school at Northwestern University in downtown Chicago, where he became a board-certified child and adolescent psychiatrist. Starting around 2006, he began making paradigmatic shifts away from conventional psychiatry, taking people off medication and diagnosis, and eventually founded Welcome to Humanity to advocate for authentic human connection and human-centered mental health approaches.
